primer: McKesson runs North America's largest drug toll-road ($403.43B FY2026 sales, $5.41B FCF) and earns a COMPOUNDER_PASS quality verdict with PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health. However, our Pass 2 audit downgrades MCK to REJECTED (TIER_0, VALUATION). After deducting $15.22B in senior claims, our DCF Base fair value is $1,160.00 (versus Finviz $1,173.21, 0.51:1). Against our $865.85 stop, $1,069.43 yields 0.45:1 R:R and even $994.71 yields 1.28:1 (<1.50:1 hurdle). With CVS concentration, $3,234M Med-Surg debt, CEO Brian Tyler's Nov 16 retirement, Nov 19 DOJ/FTC scrutiny, and O'Connor suits, Expected Value is $1,113.00 and we hold 100% CASH.
